name: Holtek HT12X 12-bit remote
description: Holtek HT12X-compatible fixed-code encoder: inverted PWM, 12-bit code, no checksum. Common in ceiling fan and gate remotes across the 315, 433, 868 and 915 MHz variants. Timing element is grounded in real devices, not a guess; fields and bit order are not. Retain draft status until an identified RAW/Key pair verifies those against this project's own pulse decoder, not just another decoder's reported value.
